pr_semantic_analysis.change_summary: The provider logic now treats DeepSeek R1 model identifiers as reasoner models in both DeepSeek and OpenAI-compatible handlers, and OpenAI-compatible configurations whose base URL contains "deepseek" now use the core OpenAI client even when the URL also matches Azure.

behavior_changes.description: When constructing an OpenAI-compatible handler, a configured base URL containing "deepseek" now selects the core OpenAI client before Azure URL detection. Consequently, a URL containing both "deepseek" and "azure.com" follows the core OpenAI client path rather than the AzureOpenAI path.
evidence: The new DeepSeek URL check precedes the existing Azure URL check.
The changeset identifies Azure-hosted DeepSeek support as the intended fix.

citations.quoted_text: Fixed to be able to use DeepSeek in Azure.

behavior_changes.description: Model identifiers containing "deepseek-r1" now enter the same existing reasoner-specific message handling path as identifiers containing "deepseek-reasoner", in both the dedicated DeepSeek handler and the OpenAI-compatible handler.
evidence: Both handlers broaden the reasoner-model test with the DeepSeek R1 identifier.
